sentences.sentence: Bekoff likens it to a behavioural kaleidoscope, with animals at play jumping rapidly between activities.
sentences.translation: 贝科夫把它比作行为的万花筒：玩耍中的动物会在不同活动之间快速切换。

sentences.sentence: "They use behaviour from a lot of different contexts - predation, aggression, reproduction," he says.
sentences.translation: “它们使用来自许多不同情境的行为——捕食、攻击、繁殖，”他说。

sentences.sentence: "Their developing brain is getting all sorts of stimulation.
sentences.translation: “它们正在发育的大脑得到了各种各样的刺激。

is getting

difficult_points: developing 是现在分词作前置定语，意为“正在发育的”。
is getting 是现在进行时，all sorts of 意为“各种各样的”；原文这句引语没有结束引号。

sentences.sentence: Not only is more of the brain involved in play than was suspected, but it also seems to activate higher cognitive processes.
sentences.translation: 参与玩耍的大脑区域不仅比原先猜想的更多，而且玩耍似乎还会激活更高层次的认知过程。

than was suspected
but it also seems to activate higher cognitive processes

difficult_points: Not only 放在句首时，后面的分句要部分倒装，所以是 is more of the brain involved。
than was suspected 是比较从句，省略了主语，意为“比原先猜想的”。
not only ... but also ... 连接两个分句；后半句的 it 指 play。

sentences.sentence: "There's enormous cognitive involvement in play", says Bekoff.
sentences.translation: “玩耍中有大量的认知参与，”贝科夫说。

structure.text: There's enormous cognitive involvement in play

difficult_points: There's 是 there is 的缩写，构成 there be 存在句。
says Bekoff 是倒装的引述分句；原文的逗号放在了引号外面。

just 加强语气，意为“简直”。
